# netbox_ipsec_profile (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/vpn/ipsecprofile/):

> An IPsec profile combines an IKE policy and an IPsec policy for a tunnel.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_ipsec_profile" "example" {
  name            = "example"
  mode            = "esp"
  ike_policy_id   = netbox_ike_policy.example.id
  ipsec_policy_id = netbox_ipsec_policy.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ike_policy_id` (Number)
- `ipsec_policy_id` (Number)
- `mode` (String) One of [esp, ah].
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String)
- `description` (String)
- `owner_id` (Number)
- `tags` (Set of String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String)
